item.title: A message from Ms. Baron & Ms. Clune:
item.description: Junior & Senior Boys Basketball meeting today at 10:40 in Room 127. Hope to see you there!

item.title: A message from Ms. Clune:
item.description: Gr. 7/8 Cross Country Athletes please come to school dressed in your athletic gear with your Ravens jersey, shoes, water, and lunch tomorrow. Turkey Trot here we come!

item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Today is the feast of Our Lady of the Holy Rosary, so today at lunch, staff and students are invited to join us to pray the rosary in the chapel, starting at 10:40. Hope to see you there!

item.title: A message from: Mrs. Curtis:
item.description: Spaces are filling up quickly for the Mobile Training Lab visiting STA at the end of the month! Grade 8 Girls are encouraged to reserve their spot by signing up with Mrs. Curtis in the Resource Room. Spend the day participating in hands-on activities related to the skilled trades, and maybe you'll even earn a spot in March's competition!

item.title: A message from MacLaren:
item.description: Congratulations to Chloe for representing STA at the EOSSAA Golf Championships yesterday in Prescott.

item.title: A message from Mr. Cornellier.
item.description: A reminder that there will be another volleyball session today after school. Girls in grades 9-12 are welcome to attend.
